_meta.note: 盲听选择题：96 课，每题 1 正确 + 2 干扰。correctIdx 为正确项下标(0/1/2)。evidence 为正确项依据句 i，conflict 为干扰项相斥句 i。AI 生成，需人工抽检。
_meta.source: question.en + sentences[].en；正确项据课文事实，干扰项与课文相斥

suspect.41: 正确项为推断，无直接原句

1.q: Why did the writer complain to the people behind him?
options: People behind him talked loudly.
The play was too long.
He could not find his seat.
zh: 他身后的人在大声说话。
戏太长。
他找不到座位。

2.q: Why was the writer's aunt surprised?
options: It was already one o'clock.
It was Sunday morning.
It was dark outside all day.
zh: 已经一点钟了。
那是星期天早上。
外面一整天都很黑。

3.q: How many cards did the writer send?
options: He sent no cards at all.
He sent thirty-seven cards.
He sent cards to all his friends.
zh: 他一张也没寄。
他寄了三十七张。
他给所有朋友都寄了。

4.q: Why is Tim finding this trip exciting?
options: He had never been abroad before.
He was tired of living in Australia.
He had already visited Perth.
zh: 他以前从没出过国。
他厌倦了住在澳大利亚。
他已经去过珀斯了。

options: Pigeons carry messages between the two garages.
He installed a telephone in the new garage.
He drives between the two garages every day.
zh: 鸽子在两个车库间传消息。
他在新车库装了电话。
他每天开车往返两个车库。

options: A beggar who calls at every house once a month.
A neighbour who lives in Bridge Street.
A policeman looking for a thief.
zh: 每月来每家一次的乞丐。
住在布里奇街的邻居。
找小偷的警察。

7.q: Did the detectives save the diamonds?
options: No — the parcel was full of stones and sand.
Yes — they saved the diamonds.
No — the thieves stole the diamonds.
zh: 没有——包裹里全是石头和沙子。
是的——他们救回了钻石。
没有——小偷把钻石偷走了。

8.q: Why is Joe's garden the most beautiful one in the town?
options: He made neat paths and built a wooden bridge.
He grew the most flowers and vegetables.
His garden was the largest in town.
zh: 他修了整齐的小路还搭了木桥。
他种的花和蔬菜最多。
他的花园是镇上最大的。

9.q: What does 'a cold welcome' refer to?
options: The big clock stopped and refused to welcome the New Year.
The Town Hall was closed that evening.
It snowed on New Year's Eve.
zh: 大钟停了，拒绝迎接新年。
那晚市政厅关门了。
新年前夜下雪了。

options: A visitor damaged it while playing jazz.
It was made in Germany in 1681.
Grandfather sold it many years ago.
zh: 一位客人弹爵士乐时弄坏了它。
它 1681 年产于德国。
祖父多年前把它卖了。

options: Tony — he made the writer pay.
The writer paid for Tony's dinner.
Tony's lawyer paid for it.
zh: 托尼——他让作者付钱。
作者替托尼付了钱。
托尼的律师付的钱。

12.q: Where is Captain Alison going and how?
options: He will sail across the Atlantic in Topsail.
He will fly to Portsmouth tomorrow.
He will stay at home for two months.
zh: 他将乘 Topsail 横渡大西洋。
他明天飞往朴次茅斯。
他将在家待两个月。

13.q: Why will the police have a difficult time?
options: They will try to keep order for the singers.
The singers will arrive by plane.
The police will give five performances.
zh: 他们要维持歌手到场时的秩序。
歌手将乘飞机到达。
警察要演出五场。

14.q: Did the young man speak English?
options: Yes — he asked the writer if he spoke English.
No — he only spoke French.
No — he said nothing during the journey.
zh: 是的——他问作者是否会说英语。
没有——他只说法语。
没有——他一路上什么也没说。

options: The writer would get an extra thousand pounds a year.
The writer was asked to leave the firm.
Twenty people would be hired.
zh: 作者每年将多拿一千英镑。
作者被要求离开公司。
将雇用二十个人。

options: A note thanking him and reminding him of the signs.
A traffic ticket for parking wrongly.
A fine from the police station.
zh: 一张道谢并提醒注意路标的便条。
一张违规停车罚单。
警察局的罚款单。

17.q: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
options: She dislikes being grown up.
She is only seventeen years old.
She never appears on the stage.
zh: 她不喜欢长大。
她只有十七岁。
她从不上台演出。

18.q: What had happened to the writer's bag?
options: The dog had taken it into the garden.
A thief had stolen it.
The writer had left it at home.
zh: 狗把它叼到花园里去了。
小偷偷走了它。
作者把它落在家里了。

19.q: When will the writer see the play?
options: Next Wednesday.
That same evening.
He will not see it at all.
zh: 下星期三。
当天晚上。
他根本看不成。

20.q: Why is fishing the writer's favourite sport?
options: He enjoys sitting in a boat doing nothing.
He catches a lot of fish.
He sells the fish he catches.
zh: 他喜欢坐在船上什么都不做。
他钓到很多鱼。
他把钓到的鱼卖掉。

21.q: Why do people think the writer is mad?
options: He stays near the noisy airport despite offers to leave.
He works at the airport.
He wants the airport to be closed.
zh: 尽管有人出钱让他搬走，他仍留在嘈杂的机场旁。
他在机场工作。
他想让机场关闭。

22.q: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
options: She sent a message in a bottle thrown into the sea.
The post office delivered it by mistake.
A friend handed it to her.
zh: 她把纸条装进瓶子扔进海里。
邮局误投了。
一个朋友转交给她。

23.q: Why is the new house special?
options: It is the only modern house in the district.
It is the largest house in the country.
It was built by the writer's sister.
zh: 它是这一带唯一的现代住宅。
它是全国最大的房子。
它是作者的姐姐建的。

24.q: Had the writer's money been stolen?
options: No — a girl found it outside his room.
Yes — it was never found.
No — he had left it at home.
zh: 没有——一个女孩在他房间外捡到了。
是的——一直没找到。
没有——他落在家里了。

25.q: Why does the writer not understand the porter?
options: He spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
The porter could not speak any English at all.
The writer spoke too quickly and unclearly.
zh: 他说话既不慢也不清楚。
搬运工根本不会说英语。
作者说得又快又不清楚。

26.q: Who is the student's best critic?
options: His seven-year-old sister.
A famous art critic.
His art teacher.
zh: 他七岁的妹妹。
一位著名的艺术评论家。
他的美术老师。

27.q: What happened to the boys in the night?
options: Water filled their tent.
They lost their sleeping bags.
Their tent caught fire.
zh: 帐篷里灌满了水。
他们把睡袋弄丢了。
他们的帐篷着火了。

options: People keep parking cars outside his gate.
His own car has been stolen.
He cannot get into his house.
zh: 人们总把车停在他家大门外。
他自己的车被偷了。
他进不了自己的房子。

29.q: Does Captain Fawcett think any trip is too dangerous?
options: Yes. He refused a trip to Rockall as too dangerous.
No. He never turns down a passenger.
No. He only flies to big, busy airports.
zh: 是的。他因太危险而拒绝飞往罗卡尔岛。
不。他从不拒绝乘客。
不。他只飞往大型繁忙的机场。

30.q: What happened to the man in the boat?
options: A ball struck him hard and he nearly fell into the water.
He fell into the river and was rescued.
He was knocked down by a passing boat.
zh: 一个球重重打在他身上，他差点掉进水里。
他掉进河里，被人救了上来。
他被一艘经过的小船撞倒了。

options: Repairing bicycles in a small shop.
Making spare parts for aeroplanes.
Running a large business company.
zh: 在一家小店里修理自行车。
制造飞机零件。
经营一家大公司。

options: The well-dressed woman.
The shop assistant.
The detective.
zh: 那位衣着考究的女士。
那名店员。
那位侦探。

33.q: Why was the girl in hospital?
options: Her boat struck a rock and she spent a night in the water.
She was hurt in a car accident.
She fell from a cliff.
zh: 她的小船撞上礁石，她在水里待了一整夜。
她在车祸中受伤。
她从悬崖上摔了下来。

34.q: How long had the police taken to find his bicycle?
options: Five days.
Twenty years.
Four hundred days.
zh: 五天。
二十年。
四百天。

35.q: How did Roy stop the thieves?
options: He drove his bus into the back of their car.
He ran after them on foot.
He shot at them.
zh: 他开公交车撞上了他们车的尾部。
他徒步追赶他们。
他朝他们开枪。

36.q: What is Debbie going to try to do?
options: Swim across the English Channel.
Row across the Channel in a small boat.
Swim from England to France.
zh: 横渡英吉利海峡。
划小船横渡海峡。
从英国游到法国。

37.q: When was the last time this country hosted the Olympic Games?
options: Never. The Games have never been held in this country before.
Four years ago.
Last year.
zh: 从来没有——这个国家以前从未举办过奥运会。
四年前。
去年。

38.q: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
options: He could not bear the cold, rainy English weather.
He wanted to return to the Mediterranean.
The house was too expensive.
zh: 他无法忍受英国寒冷多雨的天气。
他想回到地中海地区。
那房子太贵了。

39.q: Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone Dr. Millington?
options: To find out whether his operation had been successful.
To ask for a bedside telephone.
To book another operation.
zh: 想弄清楚自己的手术是否成功。
为了申请一部床边电话。
为了预约另一台手术。

40.q: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
options: No. She was busy eating and hardly spoke.
Yes. She talked about a new play.
Yes. She enjoyed a lively conversation.
zh: 不是。她只顾吃东西，几乎不说话。
是的。她谈了一出新戏。
是的。她聊得很开心。

41.q: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy,
options: Buying ties.
Buying hats.
Buying only things they need.
zh: 买领带。
买帽子。
只买他们需要的东西。

42.q: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
options: The snake went on dancing slowly.
The snake stopped dancing.
The snake danced faster.
zh: 蛇继续慢慢地“跳舞”。
蛇停了下来，不再舞动。
蛇舞动得更快了。

43.q: How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
options: He threw out two heavy food sacks to make the plane lighter.
They flew around the mountains.
The wind pushed the plane over the mountains.
zh: 他扔掉两袋沉重的食物，使飞机变轻得以爬升。
飞机绕过了群山。
风把飞机吹过了群山。

44.q: How did Mrs. Sterling get her bag back?
options: She ran after them and they dropped the bag.
The police caught the thieves.
She bought a new bag.
zh: 她追了上去，窃贼吓得丢下提包跑了。
警察抓住了窃贼。
她买了一个新包。

45.q: How did Sam get his money back?
options: The thief sent the money back little by little with notes.
The police caught the thief.
The villagers gave back all the money at once.
zh: 小偷附着字条，把钱一点一点寄了回来。
警察抓住了小偷。
村民们一次性把钱全还了回来。

46.q: What did the man in this story do?
options: He hid in a wooden box to fly from London to Sydney.
He stole a box of clothing.
He worked at Sydney airport.
zh: 他藏在木箱里，想从伦敦坐飞机到悉尼。
他偷了一箱衣服。
他在悉尼机场工作。

47.q: What evidence is there of a ghost?
options: Five empty whisky bottles and moved furniture.
The villagers admitted drinking the whisky.
Nothing unusual happened at the pub.
zh: 五个空威士忌酒瓶和被挪动的家具。
村民承认喝了那些威士忌。
酒馆里什么异常情况都没有发生。

48.q: Why did the writer become very worried?
options: He realized the dentist had pulled out the wrong tooth.
The dentist asked too many questions.
His mouth was full of cotton wool.
zh: 他意识到牙医拔错了牙。
牙医问了太多问题。
他嘴里塞满了棉花。

options: A storm blew the bed off the roof and smashed it to pieces.
The young man carried the bed back into his house unharmed.
The young man woke up before the bed hit the ground.
zh: 一阵暴风把床从屋顶吹落，摔得粉碎。
年轻人把床完好无损地搬回了屋里。
年轻人在床落地之前就醒了。

50.q: Why did the writer not get off the bus at Woodford Green?
options: The conductor forgot to put him off at Woodford Green.
The writer fell asleep and missed his stop.
The bus broke down before reaching Woodford Green.
zh: 售票员忘了让他在伍德福德草地站下车。
作者睡着了，错过了下车站。
公共汽车在到达伍德福德草地前抛锚了。

51.q: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
options: He rewarded himself with chocolate and sweets.
He forgot to write down the list of forbidden foods.
He ate only the foods allowed by his diet.
zh: 他用巧克力和糖果来奖励自己（偷吃禁食）。
他忘了列出禁吃的食物清单。
他只吃减肥清单上允许的食物。

52.q: What is the writer's carpet made of?
options: It is made of the books spread all over the floor.
It is a wool carpet bought from a shop.
It is a new carpet he bought for the new house.
zh: 它是铺满地板的一千多本书（书就是地毯）。
它是从商店买来的羊毛地毯。
它是搬进新家时买的新地毯。

options: A snake wound round the power wires and sent sparks to the ground.
Broken glass started the fire.
A cigarette end carelessly thrown away caused the fire.
zh: 一条蛇缠在高压电线上，迸出火花引发了火灾。
碎玻璃引发了火灾。
被人随手扔掉的烟头引发了火灾。

54.q: What two interruptions did the writer have?
options: The telephone rang and then the doorbell rang.
The children came home from school and interrupted her.
The doorbell rang, but it was only a neighbour borrowing sugar.
zh: 电话响了，接着门铃也响了。
孩子们放学回家打断了她。
门铃响了，但只是邻居来借糖。

options: They found a small worthless gold coin and an empty tin trunk.
They found a large amount of buried treasure.
They found nothing at all in the cave.
zh: 他们只发现了一枚几乎不值钱的小金币和一只空锡箱。
他们发现了大量埋藏的财宝。
他们在山洞里什么也没找到。

56.q: How fast did the winning car go?
options: It reached a speed of forty miles an hour.
It reached a speed of over three hundred miles an hour.
It broke down and did not finish the race.
zh: 它达到了每小时四十英里的速度。
它达到了每小时三百多英里的速度。
它中途抛锚，没能完成比赛。

57.q: Did the woman get what she wanted?
options: Yes, she finally bought the dress she had first asked for.
No, she left the shop without buying anything.
She bought a fur coat instead of the dress.
zh: 是的，她最终买下了最初想要的那条连衣裙。
没有，她什么也没买就离开了商店。
她买了一件皮大衣而不是连衣裙。

58.q: Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
options: Because the tree brings the village income from tourists.
Because he believes the tree is truly cursed.
Because tourists have stopped coming to see the tree.
zh: 因为这棵树给村子带来了游客和收入。
因为他相信这棵树真的有诅咒。
因为游客已经不再来看这棵树了。

options: Because his owner removed the gate and he was annoyed.
Because the neighbours chased him away.
Because he was hit by a car near the gate.
zh: 因为主人把大门拆掉了，瑞克斯很恼火就跑走了。
因为邻居们把它赶走了。
因为它在门口被车撞了。

60.q: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
options: Yes, his wife hurried to him and led him away to meet his sister.
No, none of her predictions came true.
A stranger, not his wife, led him away.
zh: 是的，他的妻子匆匆走向他，带他去接姐姐（预言应验了）。
没有，她的预言一个也没应验。
是一个陌生人而不是他妻子把他带走的。

61.q: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
options: Being above the atmosphere, it sends the clearest pictures of stars and galaxies.
It is important because it is the cheapest telescope ever built.
It can take photographs only from the earth's surface.
zh: 它位于大气层之上，能拍到最清晰的恒星与星系照片。
它重要是因为它是有史以来最便宜的望远镜。
它只能从地球表面拍照。

62.q: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
options: Heavy rain would wash away the soil and cause serious floods.
The fire would spread to the surrounding villages again.
Strong winds would blow the soil over the villages.
zh: 暴雨会冲走泥土并引发严重的水灾。
大火会再次蔓延到周围的村庄。
强风会把泥土吹到村庄里。

63.q: Why did Jenny want to leave the wedding reception?
options: Because she disliked seeing so many people laughing at her father.
Because the speech was boring and nobody laughed.
Because she was tired and wanted to sleep.
zh: 因为她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑她父亲。
因为演讲很无聊，没人笑。
因为她累了，想睡觉。

64.q: Why was the first tunnel not completed?
options: Because the British feared invasion at the time.
Because the plan was far too expensive.
Because the problem of ventilation could not be solved.
zh: 因为当时英国人害怕遭到入侵。
因为这个计划太昂贵了。
因为通风难题无法解决。

65.q: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
options: Because the elephant was holding up the traffic and refused to move.
Because Jumbo was ill and could not walk.
Because the police wanted to arrest the circus owner.
zh: 因为这头小象挡住了交通，而且拒绝挪动。
因为江伯生病了，走不动。
因为警察想逮捕马戏团老板。

66.q: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
options: The fourth engine, preserved in beeswax by bees, was still in perfect condition.
It was the honey stored in the plane's fuel tank.
It was the beeswax the enthusiasts used to restore the plane.
zh: 那是第四个发动机，被蜜蜂做成了蜂巢、用蜂蜡完好保存。
是飞机油箱里储存的蜂蜜。
是爱好者们用来修复飞机的蜂蜡。

67.q: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?
options: To study active volcanoes and tell us more about them.
To win fame and become rich.
To take photographs for a newspaper.
zh: 为了研究活火山，让我们了解更多关于火山的知识。
为了出名和发财。
为了给报纸拍摄照片。

68.q: Why did Elizabeth tell Nigel that
options: To stop Nigel from following her around all morning.
Because she really had a toothache and needed treatment.
Because she wanted Nigel to come with her to the dentist.
zh: 为了摆脱他，不让他一上午都跟着自己。
因为她真的牙疼，需要治疗。
因为她想让奈吉尔陪她一起去看牙医。

69.q: Do you think that the writer passed his driving test? Why?
options: No, he failed: he reacted too slowly and 'killed' the imaginary child.
Yes, he passed because he drove well in heavy traffic.
Yes, the examiner was pleased and smiled at him.
zh: 没有通过：他反应太慢，被考官说成“撞死了”那个假想的孩子。
通过了，因为他在繁忙车流中开得很好。
通过了，因为考官对他微笑、很满意。

70.q: How was the drunk removed from the ring?
options: Three men came into the ring and dragged him to safety.
The bull carried him out of the ring.
He walked out of the ring by himself.
zh: 三个人进入场地，迅速把醉汉拖到了安全处。
公牛把他驮出了场地。
他自己走出了场地。

71.q: Has Big Ben ever gone wrong?
options: Yes, once a painter's pot of paint slowed it down and it gave the wrong time.
No, it has never gone wrong or stopped.
It stopped because the Houses of Parliament burned down in 1834.
zh: 是的，有一次油漆工的油漆桶挂在指针上，使它走慢了。
没有，它从未出过故障或停过。
它因为1834年议会大厦被烧而停摆。

options: The average speed was reported as 299 but was really 301 miles per hour.
He had not actually broken the world record at all.
The car's engine was not really 2,500 horsepower.
zh: 平均速度报错了：实际是每小时301英里，而非299英里。
他其实根本没有打破世界纪录。
汽车的马力报错了，其实并不是2500马力。

73.q: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
options: No, he was taken to Perpignan and sent back to England.
Yes, the next car took him to the centre of Paris.
Yes, he went on with his journey and was never caught.
zh: 没有，他被带到了佩皮尼昂，然后被送回了英国。
是的，下一辆车把他送到了巴黎市中心。
是的，他继续旅行，始终没有被抓到。

options: Because the sheriff did not believe they were famous actors even after they told him their names.
Because the sheriff recognized them at once and asked for their autographs.
Because they had left their dark glasses at home.
zh: 因为即使他们报出姓名，治安官也不相信他们是著名演员。
因为治安官立刻认出了他们，还找他们签名。
因为他们把墨镜落在家里了。

75.q: How did the woman get help?
options: She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow, and a pilot saw the signal.
She lit a big fire to attract a passing plane.
She walked to the nearest village to call for help.
zh: 她在雪地上踩出“SOS”字样，一名飞行员看到了这个信号。
她点起一大堆火来吸引路过的飞机。
她走到最近的村庄去求救。

options: It was a fake TV news report about the macaroni harvest, broadcast on April 1st.
The announcer said the September rains had ruined the whole crop.
Mrs. Brabante won the famous macaroni-eating competition.
zh: 那是一档4月1日播出的、关于通心粉丰收的假新闻报道。
播音员说九月的雨季毁掉了全部收成。
布拉班特夫人赢得了著名的吃通心粉比赛。

77.q: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
options: No, the doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
Yes, they proved that she died of a rare disease.
Yes, the small wax figure showed the cause of death.
zh: 没有，医生们还没有确定这位妇女的死因。
是的，他们证实她死于一种罕见的疾病。
是的，那个小蜡像显示了死因。

78.q: For how long did the writer give up smoking?
options: For a whole week.
For a whole month.
He never smoked again after reading the article.
zh: 整整一个星期。
整整一个月。
读完那篇文章后他再也没有抽过烟。

79.q: Why did the plane turn back?
options: Because the police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
Because the important person on board felt frightened.
Because the plane had engine trouble after taking off.
zh: 因为警方得到消息说飞机上被人放了一枚炸弹。
因为机上那位重要人物感到害怕。
因为飞机起飞后发动机出了故障。

80.q: How many people visited the Great Exhibition of 1851?
options: Six million people.
Two million people.
Only a few thousand visitors from Europe.
zh: 六百万人。
两百万人。
只有几千名来自欧洲的参观者。

81.q: Why did the prisoner attack the driver?
options: Because he needed the car to escape from the camp as quickly as possible.
Because the elderly driver recognized him as an escaped prisoner.
Because the driver tried to raise the alarm in the camp.
zh: 因为他需要那辆车尽快逃出营房。
因为那位年长的司机认出他是个逃犯。
因为司机想在营房里拉响警报。

options: It was called an oarfish.
It was called a killer whale.
It was called a giant shark.
zh: 它被叫作皇带鱼。
它被叫作逆戟鲸。
它被叫作巨型鲨鱼。

83.q: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
options: Because he loved to hear the policeman say that Mr. Lane had been defeated.
Because he did not believe the policeman's answer.
Because he wanted to meet Mr. Lane at his house.
zh: 因为他喜欢听警察说出莱恩先生被击败的话。
因为他不相信警察的回答。
因为他想在莱恩先生家里见到他。

84.q: Who will be driving the buses next week?
options: University students will drive the buses.
The busmen themselves will drive the buses.
Owners of private cars will drive the buses.
zh: 将由大学生来开公共汽车。
将由公共汽车司机自己来开车。
将由私家车主来开公共汽车。

85.q: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
options: For a total of forty years.
For thirty years.
For more than fifty years.
zh: 总共四十年。
三十年。
五十多年。

options: The driverless speedboat was circling and came straight at them at tremendous speed.
A large shark was swimming straight towards them.
The speedboat had caught fire and was sinking fast.
zh: 无人驾驶的快艇不停转圈，并以极快的速度直冲向他们。
一条大鲨鱼正径直朝他们游过来。
快艇着火了，并且正在迅速下沉。

87.q: What was wrong with the man's story?
options: The 8 o'clock train did not run at all on the morning of the murder.
He reached the station too late to catch the 8 o'clock train.
He was not at work at 10 o'clock that day.
zh: 凶杀发生那天早上，8点钟的火车根本没有开。
他到车站太晚，没赶上8点钟的火车。
那天10点钟他并没有在上班。

88.q: Why is the rescue taking so long?
options: Because they have to drill through a hard layer of rock.
Because the trapped men are too weak to be moved.
Because the rescue workers are waiting for explosives to arrive.
zh: 因为他们必须钻透一层坚硬的岩石。
因为被困的人太虚弱，无法被抬出来。
因为救援人员正在等炸药运到。

89.q: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
options: The advertiser, because he made a slip of the tongue.
The comedians, because their show was extremely funny.
The announcer, because he told a joke on purpose.
zh: 做广告的人，因为他把话说错了。
喜剧演员们，因为他们的演出非常有趣。
播音员，因为他是故意讲了个笑话。

90.q: What kind of fish are they?
options: They are favourite eating fish such as cod and skate.
They are sharks.
They are killer whales.
zh: 它们是人类爱吃的鱼，比如鳕鱼和鳐鱼。
它们是鲨鱼。
它们是逆戟鲸。

91.q: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?
options: He was in the basket under the balloon.
He was in the control tower of the station.
He was waiting at a nearby airfield.
zh: 他在气球下面的吊篮里。
他在基地的控制塔里。
他在附近的一个机场等着。

92.q: Why did the policeman ask the writer to come to the police station?
options: Because the policeman thought the writer was cleaning windows in the middle of the night.
Because the writer had stolen a ladder from a garden shed.
Because the writer's wife had called the police.
zh: 因为警察认为作者在半夜擦窗户。
因为作者从花园小棚里偷了一架梯子。
因为作者的妻子报了警。

93.q: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
options: It was made in France, and was erected in Paris.
It was made in the United States.
It was made at New York Harbour.
zh: 它是在法国制造的，并在巴黎竖起。
它是在美国制造的。
它是在纽约港制造的。

94.q: What kind of race do the children compete in?
options: An underwater tricycle race.
A swimming race across the pool.
A game of picking up weights from the pool floor.
zh: 水下三轮车比赛。
横渡游泳池的游泳比赛。
从池底捡重物的游戏。

95.q: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
options: Because he was not wearing his hat when a shot was fired through his office window.
Because the fire extinguisher did not damage his clothes at all.
Because he was not in his office when the fire broke out.
zh: 因为有人朝办公室窗户开枪时他没有戴帽子。
因为灭火器一点也没有弄坏他的衣服。
因为起火时他并不在办公室里。

96.q: What happens to the lanterns at the end of the festival?
options: They are placed into the water and drift out to sea.
They are taken down and burned.
They are given to the children as presents.
zh: 它们被放入水中，漂向大海。
它们被取下来烧掉。
它们被当作礼物送给孩子们。
